sections.title: Morning Shift — Team 1 (06:40 – 14:30)
items: Equipment received: 4 x Keys, 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, 1 x Ops Phone.
Full suited, heading out to commence patrol down Queen Street.
Received a call from Glassons staff reporting vagrants in front of the establishment. Assistance requested to move them along.
Arrived at Glassons. Spoke to the three individuals who were compliant; a grace period granted to gather their belongings.
Vagrants complied and left the store front.
Continuing patrols, heading down Queen Street.
Standby at the corner of Queen and Wyndham Street intersection, ensuring presence is known.
Arrived at the corner of Queen and Shortland Street intersection.
Welfare check inside Imperial Lane, floor checks completed.

Received a call from Britomart McDonald's regarding a male reported masturbating in the women's bathroom while watching inappropriate videos in a stall. Staff approached the male to leave and called us to attend.

Arrived at Britomart McDonald's, conducted a sweep inside and outside. Manager relayed the male was static out front and left shortly after seeing Police in the area. Description provided; will keep a lookout.
Arrived check in Commercial Bay, commencing welfare checks.
Leaving Commercial Bay, continuing patrol en route.
Stationed at the bottom of Fort Street, commencing welfare checks.
Debrief with Team 2. Team 2 covering the top sector of CBD; Team 1 lower CBD.
Received text from Sierra cafe on Lorne Street with images and a brief description about an attempted theft.
Debrief completed; both teams deployed back into patrols.

Arrived at Sierra cafe to review surveillance footage. Male entered behaving suspiciously and erratic before reaching for the tip jar at the POS (chained, so unsuccessful); owner grabbed the jar to prevent the theft. Male then attempted to steal savouries from the front counter before the owner intervened. Male left unsuccessful. Auror report filed.
Welfare check along High Street stores and businesses, all clear.
No issues found at Freyberg Place and Women's Memorial Hall.
Arrived check in Chancery Square, all clear.
Response call from Auckland Council reporting a vagrant smoking in front of Subway, smoke entering the store and obstructing business. Team 2 notified and dispatched.
Standby at Chancery Square, waiting on further response calls.
Continuing patrols due to no issues or concerns present.
Arrived check in Wilson's Carpark, full sweep completed, no issues.
Welfare check completed on all stores and static guards in the area.
Welfare check inside Imperial Lane, floor checks completed, all clear. Standby for response calls.
Leaving standby at Imperial Lane, en route to T4 square.
Arrived at Commercial Bay, sweep conducted around the area.
Welfare check OK Gift Shop, all clear.
Welfare check Aotea Gifts and Metro Woolworths, all clear.
Arrived check in corner of Customs and Albert Street intersection, all clear.
Welfare check Albert Mart Convenience store and Discount Dairy, all clear.
Arrived Federal Square and The Cathedral church, no issues. Standby to ensure presence.
Arrived corner of Albert and Wyndham Street, all clear.
Received a call from Ippondo regarding two vagrants stationed at the store entry. Assistance requested to move the pair along.
Arrived at store. Vagrants compliant and shifted; last seen heading down Queen Street.
Break concluded, standby to recharge the ops phone (low battery).
Management needed assistance at HQ; Team 2 sent to attend.
Received a call from St Patrick's Cathedral regarding a female vagrant loitering at the entrance; caller relayed she tried to enter and appeared to slide something under the door. Team 2 dispatched.
Commencing patrols in Upper Queen Street.
Received a call from Dan at Sals Pizza on Fort Lane regarding a male and female vagrant drinking outside the establishment.
Dan called back relaying the pair had left after our call towards Wilson CP. Team 2 notified to keep a lookout.

Received a call from Puffing Kiwi regarding a male vagrant who entered the store asking customers to buy him a vape. Staff intervened checking his welfare and was met with hostility and intimidation. Incident occurred prior at 13:15. Auror report filed.
Heading back to office for handover with afternoon team.
Morning shift completed. Handover to afternoon team.

sections.title: Afternoon/Evening Shift (14:30 – 22:30)
items: Equipment received: 4 x Keys, 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, 1 x Ops Phone.
Afternoon shift deployed, standing by whilst debriefing with B Team and morning shift.
Debriefing complete. Commencing welfare checks heading down Queen Street whilst B Team head up (due to weather, patrols limited to sheltered areas).
Welfare checks on local business on Queen Street, clear.
Vulcan Lane welfare check clear. Heading to Commercial Bay.
Shortland Street clear, continuing to Commercial Bay.
Tyler Street clear, arriving at Commercial Bay.
Commercial Bay welfare check complete, standing by.
Standing down from Commercial Bay. Heading up to Chancery Square via Fort / Gore Street.
Response call from Lovisa reporting a potential thief. Vagrant description given (black top, black bottoms, black shoes, limp when walking).
Call back from Lovisa reporting the vagrant has vacated and has stolen something.
Found the vagrant, completed a full search; nothing found on him. Making way back to Lovisa, no further issues.
Gore / Fort Street welfare sweep clear. Continuing to Chancery via Freyberg and High Street.
High Street / Freyberg Square welfare sweep complete. Heading to Chancery.
Welfare check on Chancery Square complete. Heading up to the Cathedral via Federal Street.
Victoria Street heading up to Federal Street, welfare check complete. Arriving Federal Street.
Federal Street quick sweep complete. Heading to the Cathedral.
The Cathedral welfare sweep clear. Making way to Albert Street; B Team standing down, no issues.
Albert Street check complete. Welfare check on Albert Mart clear.
Lower Queen Street sweep complete. Heading up Queen Street to commence welfare sweeps.
Commencing welfare sweeps up Queen Street, heading to Aotea Square.
Welfare sweep Upper Queen Street, Darby, Elliott Street complete. Heading back to HQ for floor sweeps.
Floor checks complete. Heading back on patrol to Aotea Square.
Aotea Square full sweep clear. Heading to Lorne Street via Auckland Library.
Auckland Library check clear. Continuing onto Lorne Street.
Lorne Street sweep complete. Heading up to Victoria Street.
Victoria Street sweep complete. Heading back to HQ to charge ops phone (low battery).
Standing by for response calls whilst ops phone charging.
Ops phone at 40%, commencing patrol down Queen Street to Commercial Bay with welfare checks on Lower Queen Street.
Response call from McDonald's Britomart requesting assistance to move along a group of vagrants obstructing the entrance.
On arrival the vagrants had taken their leave, no further issues. Resuming patrol; full sweep Commercial Bay clear.
No issues. Heading to Victoria Street via Albert Street.
Victoria Street, the Cathedral, Federal Street, Albert Street sweep complete, welfare checks clear. Heading to Aotea Square.
Welfare checks complete. Continuing to patrol Queen Street, standing by for response calls.
No response calls. Heading back to HQ for 30 min.
Afternoon shift complete, standing down. Equipment accounted for, handover to night shift.

sections.title: Day Shift — Team 2 (09:00 – 17:00)
items: Equipment: 1 x Camera, 1 x Radio, 2 x Vest. Standing by HQ charging ops phone; debrief completed, area coverage confirmed.
Commencing patrols from HQ onto Queen Street towards Aotea for a full sweep.
Arrived Aotea Square, commencing a comprehensive full sweep.
Full sweep Aotea complete, no issues. Standing by to maintain a visible presence.
Commencing patrols from Aotea Square towards High Street via Lorne Street. Full comprehensive sweeps completed:
Commencing patrols from Elliot Street onto Queen Street.
Heading back towards HQ for route changeover.
Arrived HQ, new area coverage confirmed with Team 1. Standing by charging ops phone and taking first break.
Responded to a call from management requesting assistance bringing items up to office.
Management assistance completed, heading downstairs to start patrols.
Commencing patrols from HQ to Commercial Bay.
Received a response call from Team 1 regarding a female causing issues to staff at St Patrick's Cathedral on Wyndham Street.
Arrived at the Cathedral, met staff who gave a full description of the female. Headed off and kept a lookout.
Found the female on Albert Street and retained her, called Police and waited until they arrived.
Police arrived and took over; no further issues. Continuing patrols from Albert Street.

Full comprehensive sweeps done (Lower Queen Street, Customs St East, Commercial Bay, Lower Albert Street, Albert Street, Wyndham Street, Vulcan Lane, High Street, Chancery Square, Victoria St West, Federal Street). Welfare checks completed:
Convenience stores on Albert / Victoria Street
Continuing final patrols towards Aotea Square through Federal Street and Wellesley Street West.
Arrived Aotea Square, commencing a comprehensive full sweep.
Full sweep Aotea Square complete. Crossing to Lorne Street.
Received a response call regarding a female blasting loud music outside a store on Queen Street causing a disturbance; shop owner requested she be moved away.
Arrived at the store; approached the woman and her partner and advised them to move along as the music was causing a disturbance. Both complied and moved on, no further issues.
Interaction with a tourist who was lost and wanted directions to the Auckland Ferry Terminal. Escorted him to Queen Street and directed him towards Commercial Bay, no further issues.
Heading back to HQ from Albert Street.
Arrived HQ, finishing off reports and Auror reports.
Team 2 standing down, equipment accounted for, handover completed.

Check in Chemist Warehouse / Kathmandu, no issues.
Check in Vulcan Lane, all clear.
Check in Britomart Maccas, no issues.
Patrolling Commercial Bay, commencing full sweep.
Commercial Bay full sweep complete, all clear.
Check in Albert Street Convenience store, no issues.
Check in Ace Karaoke, no issues.
Check in 77 Convenience store, no issues.
Full sweep Victoria Street, all clear.
Check in Queen Street Maccas, no issues.
Patrolling Aotea Square, commencing full sweep.
Aotea Square full sweep complete, all clear.
Check in Queen Street Maccas, no issues.
Full sweep Freyberg / Chancery Square / Kitchener Street, all clear.
Full sweep Fort Street / Wilson Carpark, all clear.
Check in Gore Street, all clear.
Check in Aotea Gifts, no issues.
Check in St Patrick's Cathedral church, all clear.
Check in 77 Convenience store, no issues.
Full sweep Victoria Street, all clear.
Check in corner Lorne Street / Wakefield, all clear.
Check in Aotea Square, all clear.
Check in Queen Street Maccas, no issues. Heading back to HQ to charge ops phone (6%).
Heading back out on patrols, phone at 48%.
Headed up Victoria Street, checking in 77 Convenience store, no issues.
Check in St Patrick's Cathedral church, all clear.
Full sweep Wyndham Street, all clear.
Check in Durham Street, all clear. Check in Vulcan Lane, all clear.
Check in Britomart Maccas, no issues.
Streets quiet, only a few vagrants seen; otherwise clear. Media on file: POI from 175 Queen Street, POI from the Cathedral (photos on file).
